json_ld.description: The first-ever Quencher from Stanley 1913 + TOGETHXR — built for those who show up, game day, every day, and everywhere in between.TOGETHXR lives at the center of women's sports — built by athletes, for everyone who believes women's sports deserve the same spotlight. We believe that too. And since Stanley 1913 lives at the center of hydration, joining forces with TOGETHXR just makes sense. Featuring original art by Kelly Anna, the London-based artist known for her bold, movement-driven figures and unapologetic celebration of women in sports. Her vibrant style captures strength in motion — exactly the energy this collab deserves. Her artwork lives on our 30-ounce Quencher H2.0, which features a comfort-grip handle and narrow base that fits most cup holders. The advanced Flowstate™ lid rotates between three positions — a straw opening with splash-resistant seal, a drink opening, and full cover top. *Not Eligible For Promotions or Resell. Multiple & Large Orders Are Subject To Cancellation.
